sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.

sections.text: Trabectedin has a US histology-based indication for adults with unresectable or metastatic liposarcoma after an anthracycline-containing regimen; DDIT3 fusion status is not the sole eligibility criterion.

audit_evidence.scope: Adults with unresectable/metastatic liposarcoma or leiomyosarcoma previously treated with anthracycline-containing regimen.

sections.text: EWSR1::DDIT3 is a myxoid liposarcoma fusion confirmed by RNA sequencing. A directly documented tumor had diffuse DDIT3 expression despite a negative DDIT3 break-apart FISH result.

audit_evidence.scope: Fusion-targeted RNA sequencing detected EWSR1-DDIT3 in a myxoid liposarcoma with negative DDIT3 break-apart FISH and diffuse DDIT3 expression. No direct EWSR1-DDIT3 differentiation-block experiment.
